name: DFW Qualifier 2025
information: Note: This competition is on a Sunday. - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025#54274-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. ## ***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.*** This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC.
